item.description: Here's your Woodchuck Weather. High temperatures this afternoon range from sixty-four to sixty-seven degrees with skies mostly cloudy to cloudy across the region, and a chance of rain mainly in southern areas. Tonight, expect lows between forty-four and forty-six degrees, continued mostly cloudy to cloudy skies, and scattered light rain possible in many spots. Precipitation chances today and tonight range from as low as three percent in the north to nearly fifty percent in the south, but any rainfall will be light and generally less than a tenth of an inch.
